name: Full Art Spire
author: tzii
description: Visual-only full art for every Slay the Spire 2 card: all 577 of the main game and all new cards of the v0.113.1-v0.114.0 public beta, with layered parallax depth and rarity finishes from subtle satin on commons to prismatic on the rarest cards. Unofficial fan project; no gameplay changes. Original art (c) Mega Crit; the full-art extensions and backgrounds are AI-generated from it.
